$comment: Per-state, per-section requirements (M3). Started with the rows exercised by the group A launch-copy tickets; the rest of the Open state and the other states follow. Each row: requirement, source, owner when missing, check, exemplar.

campus.hero.identity.content: H1 "Alpha <Campus>"; subtitle "<grade range> Private School in <City>, <State>" with the HubSpot grade range and the HubSpot city/state.
campus.hero.identity.source: HubSpot Programs (name, grade range, city, state); decision 2026-09-15 that HubSpot is the source of truth

campus.hero.ctas.content: CTA row: STAY IN-THE-KNOW, Attend an Info Session, Book a Call, Apply now. Each resolves to a reachable, campus-specific destination.
campus.hero.ctas.source: demonstrated-correct pages (44 of 44 carry the first three; 39 carry Book a Call)
campus.hero.ctas.ownerWhenMissing: campus admissions owner for destinations; Elementor owner for a missing button

campus.intro.status-sentence.content: "Alpha <Campus> is open and enrolling." as the first sentence of the intro text widget, followed by the "Join us for an info session" paragraph. No launch-era wording anywhere on the page: Coming Soon, Coming Fall, Launching, Opening <season>.
campus.intro.status-sentence.source: HubSpot state Open (decision 2026-09-15); wording from exemplars Plano and Scottsdale; requirement catalog rule on stale launch copy

campus.intro.media.content: Intro card slot shows this campus's approved open-state media: the "<Campus> Open and Enrolling" card from the September 7 template set, or an approved campus video. Never a launch-era graphic, another campus's image, or unrelated footage.
campus.intro.media.source: registry/campus-open-media.json; requirement catalog rule on launch media and approved video
campus.intro.media.ownerWhenMissing: Yash Chitneni (cards); Matt or Yash (video approval)

campus.intro.heading.content: "Welcome to the Future of Education in <City>"
campus.intro.heading.note: The word "education" is on MacKenzie's hold list; do not rewrite this heading until she decides.

site.header.rendered.content: Theme-builder header with stylesheet, logo, navigation, Contact Us; footer present.

campus.resources.packet.required: when an approved current packet exists
campus.resources.packet.content: Info packet CTA links to a public, logged-out-reachable document for this campus and school year.
campus.resources.packet.source: requirement catalog; group A replay found 401s on Oklahoma City, South Bay LA, Tulsa
campus.resources.packet.ownerWhenMissing: info_packet path: campus requester + marketing-collateral + brand-authority + expansion-founding + website-operations (packet-owner person is an open gap; not Dmitry Bakaev)

campus.intro.status-sentence.content: A launch statement naming the month or season and the year, for example "Alpha Bethesda opens January 2027." "Coming soon" alone is a defect.
campus.intro.status-sentence.source: APEX ticket cmsuma22l000804juh8fq4nrs (Alpha Bethesda, rachel@alpha.school, August 2026); requirement catalog
campus.intro.status-sentence.ownerWhenMissing: program record owner for the date
